title: Label unsupported judgment
statement: Every material recommendation must cite applicable evidence, policy, or precedent, or be explicitly labelled unsupported judgment.
rationale: Judgment remains useful, but it must not masquerade as evidence.

title: No silent authority mutation
statement: Derived analysis and experiments may become canonical changes only through an explicit reviewed proposal.
rationale: Canonical game sources remain authoritative and reversible.

title: Preserve critic disagreement
statement: Material critic disagreement must be shown as a trade-off rather than averaged into a consensus score.
